item.title: Arab parties extend a hand to try and topple Netanyahu, but challenges remain
item.description: A veteran Arab lawmaker in Israel says his bloc is willing to break with decades of precedent and join forces with Jewish-led parties in a shared bid to end Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s long rule.

item.title: Former Chinese Politburo member Ma Xingrui charged with taking bribes
item.description: China's state media say a former member of one of China’s top decision-making bodies has been formally charged with accepting bribes a week after Communist Party leaders confirmed his expulsion from the party.

item.title: Once a teen activist, Hong Kong's Joshua Wong is spending years of his adult life in prison
item.description: Joshua Wong, once a rising political star in Hong Kong's pro-democracy movement, has been sentenced again under Beijing's national security law.

item.title: Asian shares mostly advance following US midterms, though Kospi falls on selling of chipmakers
item.description: Asian shares are mostly higher after U.S. stocks rallied following the midterm election, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average jumping more than 3%.

item.title: Australia approves seabed site where a Japanese company will store carbon pollution
item.description: The Australian government has designated a seabed storage site off its northern coast where a Japanese company plans to store hundreds of millions of tons of carbon dioxide using a technology that has divided climate scientists.
